tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Undergraduate and graduate components of the Donald M. Payne International Development Fellowship Program may conduct outreach to attract outstanding students with an interest in pursuing a Foreign Service career who represent diverse ethnic and socioeconomic backgrounds.

tree.heading: Review of past programs
tree.text: The Secretary shall review past programs designed to increase minority representation in international affairs positions.

notes.heading: Definition
notes.text: For definition of “Secretary” as used in this section, see section 5002 of Pub. L. 117–81, set out as a note under section 263c of this title.
